facts.statement: Penelopognathus is a genus of hadrosauroid dinosaur that lived in the Early Cretaceous Bayin-Gobi Formation in modern-day China.
facts.quote: Penelopognathus (meaning "wild duck jaw") is a genus of hadrosauroid dinosaur which lived in the Early Cretaceous Bayin-Gobi Formation in what is now China.

facts.statement: The type species Penelopognathus weishampeli was named after David Weishampel and described by Godefroit, Li, and Shang in 2005 from fragmentary jaw fossils.
facts.quote: The type species, Penelopognathus weishampeli, named after David Weishampel, was described by Godefroit, Li, and Shang in 2005, based on fragmentary jaw fossils.

facts.statement: Adult Penelopognathus reached a length of about 5 meters and a height of about 2 meters.
facts.quote: Penelopognathus grew up to around 5 m long and around 2 m tall when fully grown.

facts.statement: Penelopognathus weishampeli is the only known species of the extinct genus Penelopognathus, an ornithopod dinosaur belonging to the Iguanodontia.
facts.quote: Penelopognathus weishampeli es la única especie conocida del género extinto Penelopognathus ("mandíbula de pato extraña") de dinosaurio ornitópodo iguanodontiano

facts.statement: The dinosaur lived during the middle Cretaceous, specifically the Albian stage, approximately 100 million years ago in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico en el Albiense, hace aproximadamente entre 100 millones de años en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: The type species was described based on a single straight, elongated jawbone with about 20 irregular holes on its outer surface.
facts.quote: La especie tipo Penelopognathus weishampeli, fue descrita por Godefroit, Li & Shang en 2005, basado en una sola mandíbula, recta y alongada que en su cara externa esta perforada por alrededor de 20 forámenes irregulares.

facts.statement: The holotype indicates that Penelopognathus is more derived than Altirhinus but more primitive than Probactrosaurus.
facts.quote: El holotipo lo muestra más avanzado que Altirhinus pero más primitivo que Probactrosaurus.

facts.statement: Fossils found in the Gobi Desert, Mongolia, from the same period suggest that non-hadrosaurid Hadrosauriformes were well diversified in the early Cretaceous and that Asia is the origin of this group.
facts.quote: Aunque también pertenece al área del Desierto de Gobi, Mongolia, aproximadamente en el mismo periodo, lo que muestra que los Hadrosauriformes no hadrosáuridos estaban bien diversificados a principios del Cretácico, sugiriendo que Asia es el origen de este grupo.

facts.statement: Penelopognathus lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian age.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Penelopognathus belongs to the parent group Hadrosauroidea.
The discovery of Penelopognathus supports the hypothesis that hadrosauroids originated in Asia.
facts.quote: The discovery of this taxon contributes to the hypothesis that hadrosauroids originated in Asia.
